title: Q-RES-perez-lopez-1974-P7: The member knowing better than the organization (measured 72, target <= 0)
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** research pass: perez-lopez-1974 finding P7 is not-met (measured 72)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation research --probe perez-lopez-1974:P7
**Prediction:** owner_interventions_7d <= 0 within 336 h
**Out of scope:** editing the study, its target or the paper to match the code; the measurement is changed only by changing the mechanism
**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation research --probe perez-lopez-1974:P7`
**Status:** open

Concern: The member knowing better than the organization. The study: Organizational values forbid tasks that do not satisfy a member's needs "even though that fact may not be known to the individual", and "an organization will be successful insofar as it knows better than the individual himself what actions by the individual will satisfy the individual's needs." Each time the owner has to step in and correct the system, the reverse held.

Mechanisms that should answer it: IGNORANCE-1 (foundation/ignorance.py); BLINDSPOT-1 (foundation/blindspots.py); SECOND-LOOP-2 (foundation/ultrastability.py).

Metric: owner-driven thread sessions that changed the repository in the last 7 days (ops/provenance.jsonl), target <= 0. Improve the mechanism (or add one) until the probe passes; the white paper at /research updates itself from the same measurement.
